name: rosetta-sort-an-outline-at-every-level
code:
use default

class NODE(text: string, children: LIST[NODE])

union Outcome is
    SORTED(lines: List[string]) default
    INCONSISTENT(reason: string)
si

indent_of(line: string) -> string =>
    line
        |> take_while(letter => letter == ' ' \/ letter == '\t')
        |> join("")

build(lines: List[string], unit: int) -> NODE is
    let root = NODE("", LIST[NODE]())
    let ancestors = LIST[NODE]()

    ancestors.add(root)

    for line in lines do
        let level = indent_of(line).length / unit + 1
        let node = NODE(line.trim(), LIST[NODE]())

        while ancestors.count > level do
            ancestors.remove_at(ancestors.count - 1)
        od

        ancestors[ancestors.count - 1].children.add(node)
        ancestors.add(node)
    od

    root
si

sort_tree(node: NODE, descending: bool) is
    let ordered =
        if descending then
            node.children |> sort_by_descending(child => child.text)
        else
            node.children |> sort_by(child => child.text)
        fi

    let ranked = ordered |> collect()

    node.children.clear()

    for child in ranked do
        node.children.add(child)

        sort_tree(child, descending)
    od
si

flatten(node: NODE, level: int, pad: string) -> Pipe[string] is
    if level >= 0 then
        yield "{repeat(pad, level) |> join("")}{node.text}"
    fi

    for child in node.children do
        yield in flatten(child, level + 1, pad)
    od
si

arrange(outline: List[string], descending: bool) -> Outcome is
    let indents = outline |> map(indent_of) |> collect()
    let leading = indents |> find(indent => indent.length > 0)

    if !leading? then
        return Outcome.SORTED(outline)
    fi

    let unit = leading
    let marker = unit[0]

    for indent in indents do
        if indent |> any(letter => letter != marker) then
            return Outcome.INCONSISTENT("indentation mixes tabs and spaces")
        fi

        if indent.length % unit.length != 0 then
            return Outcome.INCONSISTENT(
                "an indent of {indent.length} is not a multiple "
                "of the unit of {unit.length}")
        fi
    od

    let root = build(outline, unit.length)

    sort_tree(root, descending)

    Outcome.SORTED(flatten(root, -1, unit) |> collect())
si

show(title: string, outline: List[string], descending: bool) is
    write_line("{title}:")

    let outcome = arrange(outline, descending)

    if outcome? then
        outcome.lines |> each(line => write_line("  {line}"))
    else
        write_line("  inconsistent: {outcome.reason}")
    fi

    write_line()
si

let spaced =
    ["zeta", "    beta", "    gamma", "        lambda", "        kappa",
     "        mu", "    delta", "alpha", "    theta", "    iota",
     "    epsilon"]

let tabbed =
    ["zeta", "\tgamma", "\t\tmu", "\t\tlambda", "\t\tkappa", "\tdelta",
     "\tbeta", "alpha", "\ttheta", "\tiota", "\tepsilon"]

let mixed_characters =
    ["alpha", "    epsilon", "\tiota", "    theta", "zeta", "    beta",
     "    delta", "    gamma", "    \tkappa", "        lambda",
     "        mu"]

let mixed_widths =
    ["zeta", "    beta", "   gamma", "        lambda", "         kappa",
     "        mu", "    delta", "alpha", "    theta", "    iota",
     "    epsilon"]

show("four spaces, ascending", spaced, false)
show("four spaces, descending", spaced, true)
show("tabs, ascending", tabbed, false)
show("tabs, descending", tabbed, true)
show("mixed indent characters", mixed_characters, false)
show("mixed indent widths", mixed_widths, false)
